# Shaun Parkison — sparkison.dev

> Shaun Parkison is a full stack developer based in Fort Collins, Colorado, and the
> creator of the m3u suite — open source, self-hosted IPTV tools (m3u editor, m3u proxy,
> and m3u tv). He is available for freelance projects, ongoing development, consulting,
> and full-time senior full stack roles, working remotely.

Key facts:
- Specialties: Laravel & PHP back ends, Python services, React / Next.js / Vue.js
  front ends, Flutter & React Native mobile and TV apps, Docker, Redis, FFmpeg.
- Certified senior Laravel developer (official Laravel certification program).
- B.S. in Computer Science (minor in Mathematics), Colorado State University.
- Experience: Senior Developer at NerdyMind Marketing (2015–2024); independent
  studio owner & lead developer (2009–present); creator & maintainer of the
  m3u suite (2024–present).
- Contact: hello@sparkison.dev
- GitHub: https://github.com/sparkison and https://github.com/m3ue
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/shaun-parkison-254a2218/

## Pages

- [Home](https://sparkison.dev/): who Shaun is, featured work, tech stack, FAQ, contact
- [Services](https://sparkison.dev/services/): what he builds, how he works, engagement types (project builds, ongoing development, consulting & audits, full-time roles)
- [m3u suite](https://sparkison.dev/m3u-suite/): overview of the suite, features per app, architecture, install FAQ
- [Resume](https://sparkison.dev/resume/): work experience, selected projects, skills, education & certification

## Projects

- [m3u editor](https://github.com/sparkison/m3u-editor): self-hosted IPTV playlist manager — EPG management (XMLTV, Schedules Direct), Xtream API output, .strm sync, post-processing automation. Docs: https://m3ue.sparkison.dev/
- [m3u proxy](https://github.com/sparkison/m3u-proxy): high-performance streaming proxy — failover, management API, hardware-accelerated FFmpeg transcoding.
- [m3u tv](https://github.com/m3ue/m3u-tv): cross-platform Flutter client for Android TV, Apple TV, and mobile.
